name: agentic-paper-reviewer
description: Detailed, grounded AI feedback on a research paper before you submit it: reads the whole PDF, searches arXiv for related work, writes an ICLR-style referee report with every point tied to the paper or a cited arXiv paper, and scores 7 dimensions into a 1-10 overall. Follows the pipeline published by paperreview.ai (Stanford Agentic Reviewer).
